Critics Consensus A visually dazzling space odyssey that's carried along effortlessly by the gravitational pull of Ryan Gosling at his most winning, Project Hail Mary is a near-miraculous fusion of smarts and heart. Read Critics Reviews Audience Says One stellar Gosling + one arachnid-ish alien + one Hail Mary mission = lightning in a spaceship. Read Audience Reviews Keith Uhlich (All (Parentheses)) (Substack) Apr 6 It runs two hours and thirty-something minutes. Feels like it lasts forty-six years. And among the many things I didn’t need in my life was a stealth sequel to Half Nelson…in space. Go to Full Review David Sims The Atlantic Apr 2 This film is not quite the masterpiece its grand visual scale sometimes suggests it’s shooting for. Still, it’s pretty consistently enjoyable, with a message that the viewing public could afford to hear. Go to Full Review Stephanie Zacharek TIME Magazine Mar 27 This is the most ambitious picture, in terms of structure and spectacle, that the filmmaking duo of Lord and Miller have ever made, and sometimes it reels out of their grasp. Go to Full Review Dorothy Woodend The Tyee (British Columbia) 2d Adapted from Andy Weir’s 2021 novel, the film stays true to the major plot points of Weir’s work, with the bonus addition of Gosling’s incontrovertible charm to add to the action. Go to Full Review Michael Calleri Niagara Gazette 3d Gosling is the audience’s representative on the screen and they’ll follow him anywhere, not because they have to, but because the actor has an everyman persona to which moviegoers will gravitate. His character is smart and likable. Go to Full Review Brooke Obie Black Girl Watching 4d It’s unnecessarily long. And after decades of this patriarchal, white supremacist, American military propaganda, I’ve simply had enough. Go to Full Review Read all reviews Nicolas 2h Wonderful, Heartfelt and Moving! Steve M 2h Amaze! Amaze! Amaze! Alex 3h it was so visually stunning Brooklyn 3h A pure movie about friendship and hope that everyone can watch regardless of who you are, what you believe in, and where you come from. We need more movies like this. See more Kevin 3h Phenomenal. A 100% complete movie from start to finish. A masterclass in storytelling. Lori 5h It was very interesting and suspenseful. Everyone in the theater was was paying attention to the movie, the only time that there was a sound was when something funny was said. Great ending. As his memory returns, he begins to uncover his mission: solve the riddle of the mysterious substance causing the sun to die out. He must call on his scientific knowledge and unorthodox ideas to save everything on Earth from extinction... but an unexpected friendship means he may not have to do it alone.
